scientific_integrity: Two distinct complete integer enumeration implementations, explicit witness signs, independently recomputed shift autocorrelations, and complete symmetry orbit partition. No extrapolation from finite size to infinite families. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive result for the fixed nineteen-point hexagonal support, real binary signs, and integrated fourth moment only. It neither optimizes arbitrary complex phases nor proves asymptotic results for larger hexagonal shells. Some older specialized array tables were available only as abstracts; historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp binary Fourier flatness on the nineteen-point hexagonal aperture
